newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MMS Gulf office seeks to improve service.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MMS Gulf office seeks to improve service.

text.p: In a move to save time and money for the oil and gas industry, the U.S. Minerals and Management Service said Wednesday its Gulf of Mexico regional office in New Orleans was going to speed up paperwork and use the Internet more.
The region's lease adjudication office said it would post lease sale statistics on its World Wibe Web site -- http://www.mms.gov -- to give customers immediate, free access to the information.
Among other steps, the office said it would cut the cost of copies and certifications by 90 percent and reduce the waiting period for new lease assignements by 75 percent.
MMS planned to phase in other changes over the next year, including eliminating multiple filing of original documents and providing electronic access to non-proprietary agency lease information.
